programme: Flow semantic modernization and idiom adoption
authority: GitHub issues/PRs and exact-revision compiler tests are authoritative. This file defines proposed work, not live status or approval.
task_selection: Select minimal priority value with dependencies verified complete and no live overlapping issue, PR or claim. Design-gated packages require explicit approval before language/API/security changes. Open one issue per concrete slice if none exists.
live_status: Do not store is_done or in_progress here. Determine them from GitHub issues, merged PRs and evidence; this manifest intentionally has no status field.

packages.title: Generate comprehensive Flow feature census
packages.scope: Enumerate all public surface forms, separate parser/DSL expander/API/experimental proposals, and connect grammar, typecheck, lowering, runtime fixtures, backend and docs by file path. Exclude generated proofs and fixtures from adoption denominator.
acceptance: Reproducible machine-readable baseline at exact SHA with missing anchors distinguished from missing implementations
Each feature has confidence and maturity, not an invented shipped label
Counts classify source, generated, proof, negative and pedagogical files

packages.title: Build documentation contradiction ledger
packages.scope: Compare every current-tense feature claim with exact compiler and test evidence, including stale Python-host references, RK4, connect, represent and unit-aware evolution claims.
acceptance: A per-claim path/line evidence ledger with current correction and proposed status
Documentation-only fixes landed in narrowly scoped PRs; historical design preserved or marked archive

packages.title: Decide canonical feature metadata ownership and schema
packages.scope: Specify one authoritative registry or source-to-generated card pipeline, stable feature IDs, lifecycle tier, target compatibility, exact tests and evidence revision. Do not hand-maintain multiple truth matrices.
acceptance: Design record states source owner, schema, regeneration and version policy
Unknown/not verified distinct from unsupported and proposed
No implementation of new semantics without approval

packages.title: Implement a feature registry with evidence validation
packages.scope: Implement in Flow a source-owned, validation-capable feature ledger and derived views. Audit links/paths/test anchors, refuse stale unverified promises.
acceptance: Feature cards generated and reproducible at exact SHA
Bad/missing anchors fail with actionable errors
Source provenance and backend support recorded separately

packages.title: Inventory eligible idiom-adoption candidates
packages.scope: Classify code by purpose and mathematical structure; tag canonical, pedagogical, independent reference, performance, adversarial fixture, proof-only, target-only and legacy. Discover cases of duplicated hand integration, raw dimensioned APIs and manual sampling.
acceptance: Per-file or per-package candidate map with measurable eligibility rules
No reclassification of examples/verify as ordinary runnable examples
Each proposed rewrite identifies risks, reference, cost and intended checker

packages.title: Baseline agent-generated Flow idiom selection
packages.scope: Create evaluation prompts/cases across ODE, DAE, sampled control, effectful shell, data pipelines, memory and RT; measure correct high-level selection and unjustified feature overuse before training guidance.
acceptance: Blind evaluated baseline and scoring rubric at a pinned Flow revision
Outputs compile or are explicitly classified unsupported
Both false-positive and missed-idiom rates reported

packages.title: Map in-flight issues, PR overlap and release constraints
packages.scope: Refresh live GitHub tasks, paths, branch conflicts and protected merge rules before any work package is claimed. Link to existing #1703/#1694 and already-implemented #761 rather than duplicating.
acceptance: Live overlap mapping and exact-head evidence links
No duplicate implementation PR spawned
Unclaimed task selection demonstrated on a dry run

packages.title: Prove units plus evolved derivative type checking
packages.scope: Reproduce unit-member derivative emission and dimension validation; decide whether derivatives carry dimensions through the semantic layer or are checked and then erased; implement only after approved design.
acceptance: Distance/time and acceleration RHS accepted; distance RHS as velocity derivative rejected
Unit-typed states survive generated Euler/RK4 without invalid casts
Both incorrect algebra and hidden f64 coercion negative tests

packages.title: Make time, solver and unit bridge coherent
packages.scope: Verify solver dt, fixed-period accumulation, simultaneous state updates, RK4 stages and typed time conversion. Document intentional numeric erasure and event granularity.
acceptance: dt unit misuse rejected where syntax supports it
No silent change to scheduling or update order
Analytic time and convergence regression cases

packages.title: Inventory exact equation-style mathematical syntax
packages.scope: Extract real accepted equation/function notations from compiler fixtures and distinguish mathematical prose rendering, algebraic residuals, ODE RHS, DAE/MNA, symbolic PDE and ordinary typed function expressions.
acceptance: Every advertised mathematical syntax has a real small compilable fixture
Desired but unsupported notation is proposed rather than claimed shipped
Document precise precedence, type and evaluation constraints

packages.title: Define equation/DAE/ODE/PDE selection and solver ownership
packages.scope: Set domain distinctions: explicit ODE vs algebraic constraint vs index-1 DAE vs discretized spatial PDE. Decide what belongs in syntax, typed library builder or solver IR without rushing new grammar.
acceptance: Counterexample ideal-voltage-source circuit does not get forced into evolves
Solver convergence and data-dependency policy specified
No conflation of renderer notation with executable expressions

packages.title: Fix ordered floating-point reduction safety
packages.scope: Coordinate with existing issue #1694 and its PR history. Specify exact sequential/contractible/reorderable reduction rules and vectorization hints before making any idiom rule recommend aggregation or parallelization.
acceptance: Known non-associative reduction reproduces expected ordered result under chosen contract
Elementwise vectorization retained where safe
Generated C/MLIR inspected and numerical regression runs at multiple optimizations

packages.title: Verify hybrid events, guarantees, invariants and reset semantics
packages.scope: Test when/reaches behavior, zero-crossing granularity, reset-before/after outputs, always/never/guarantee runtime semantics, no false proof claims and event serialization.
acceptance: Time-step refinement and threshold crossing tests
Simultaneous reset and failure trap negative cases
Docs distinguish sampled runtime check from formal invariant

packages.title: Validate effect/capability/handler contracts and target parity
packages.scope: Verify effect rows, stateless capability scope, nested handler replacement, strict/permissive mode, impurity inside derivatives, unknown operations and honest MLIR support.
acceptance: Unhandled effects rejected in strict profile
Nested handlers have known evaluation and restoration order
MLIR parity or explicit unsupported diagnostic, no silent fallback

packages.title: Validate connection topology, rates and linear representations
packages.scope: Test nested flow ports, same-unit conversion, state-broken feedback, algebraic-loop rejection, represent linear explicit Jacobian, limited system sizes and dsys/sense/analyze interplay.
acceptance: Nonzero-dimensional mismatch and algebraic loop fail with useful diagnostics
Named model works with independent state-space oracle
No automatic Jacobian claim without implementation

packages.title: Reconcile field, typed symbolic PDE and physics DSL
packages.scope: Coordinate with PR #1703 and Sofia solver design; separate 1D field expander, typed PDE DAG, boundary/timestep/numerical convergence and @physics status. Do not merge unapproved APIs into stable docs.
acceptance: Boundary and unit invalid cases pinned
Independent analytic and semi-discrete reference tests
Compiler/API maturity state and GPU/backend reach explicitly labelled

packages.title: Differentiation, tensor and symbolic algebra contracts
packages.scope: Audit Dual/Tensor operator legality, reverse-mode available forms, function expressions, numeric stability and effect/aliasing restrictions; avoid teaching non-existent loss.grad syntax.
acceptance: Gradient check vs finite difference and reference implementation
Unit-bearing differentiation where supported or explicit diagnostic
Backend matrix and performance reference

packages.title: Make pipeline/fork/choose and implementation selection semantics explicit
packages.scope: Validate single evaluation, effect order, parenthesis and placeholder behavior, alternative selection provenance, side effects and floating-point safety; keep @require attribute ideas marked future until wired.
acceptance: Side-effect and aliasing negative cases
Exact implementable plan/sort/search syntax demonstrated
flow explain reports selected legal plans and reasons

packages.title: Cross-module real-time, lifetime and resource contracts
packages.scope: Verify transitive blocking/alloc/IO/UNKNOWN, function pointers, closures, trait dispatch, annotated lifetimes, scratch/stack limits and call graph holes; do not equate @rt_safe with measured worst-case deadlines.
acceptance: Deliberately unsafe callback and unknown extern rejected
Safe bounded callback accepted with independent runtime check
Profile limitations documented on all supported targets

packages.title: Conformance matrix and backend truth
packages.scope: Define exact compatibility test for C/native, MLIR verified/native, C->WASM, GPU/JS where appropriate, refusing unsupported syntax instead of silent semantic change.
acceptance: Per-feature target status supported/unsupported/unverified with revision
Same source and assertions on claimed targets
One negative regression for misleading successes

packages.title: Compiler explainability and representation-loss diagnostics
packages.scope: Show why an abstraction is selected, rewritten, limited or rejected; do not erase physical time/units/effect/numeric constraints just to obtain an optimization.
acceptance: Representative source-to-lowering trace with stable fields and exact revision
Invalid rewrite counterexample refused with provenance
Build/profile and cost evidence separated from semantics

packages.title: Dimensioned transport and vehicle flagship
packages.scope: Make a small braking/longitudinal vehicle model canonically equation-first with typed quantities, independent analytic solution and deliberately wrong units test. Keep the original numeric reference.
acceptance: Analytic distance/time and RK4 convergence tested
Compile-time units failure proved
C/MLIR statuses and measured cost recorded

packages.title: Hybrid controller flagship with capability-selected environment
packages.scope: Build/reference a thermostatic/servo hybrid with continuous plant, sampled controller, event reset, model checks, and effect-swappable telemetry/time/IO shell.
acceptance: Live and simulated handlers produce same pure model trajectory
Periodic rate and invariant checks asserted
No effects called from derivative RHS

packages.title: Circuit DAE anti-example and MNA reference
packages.scope: Demonstrate when NOT to use evolves: ideal voltage sources plus algebraic KCL, MNA reference vs genuine RC ODE, with units and residual tolerance.
acceptance: KCL and power residual tests, singular-network negative case
No misleading proof of general nonlinear DAE
Measured values match analytic reference

packages.title: Field/PDE flagship with truthful solver and boundary limits
packages.scope: Show a 1D heat model with dimensioned coefficients where implemented, stable timestep, convergence and independent eigenmode reference; stage broader Sofia only through approved PR.
acceptance: Stability and boundary error cases
Convergence measured over dt and dx
Experimental vs stable separated in demos

packages.title: DSP and real-time callback flagship
packages.scope: Demonstrate an effect-free allocation-free signal kernel, host capabilities at the boundary, span ownership, typed rates and latency evidence; compare a procedural reference.
acceptance: Transitive RT contract passes strict mode
No hidden allocation/lock in measured kernel
Golden sample signal equivalence and bounded performance measured

packages.title: General dataflow/functional composition flagship
packages.scope: Create an executable problem-driven pipeline/fork/choose/match example with side-effect order checks and ordinary function fallback when it is clearer.
acceptance: Source evaluated once and appropriate named records tested
No change in observable effects through optimization
Comparison with plain code includes rationale not just line count

packages.title: Unit-safe standard-library API audit
packages.scope: Classify public f64/f32 parameters by dimension and API stability. Propose minimal typed wrappers/overloads, safe conversions and compatibility plan where semantics matter; do not indiscriminately replace all scalars.
acceptance: Per-module signature map and selected, versioned migration
FFI/ABI and profiler checks
Invalid dimensional mixes rejected by dedicated tests

packages.title: Numerical integrators and control utilities modernization
packages.scope: Remove duplicated application-level solver policy only where high-level Flow can own it; preserve lower-level integrators as tested general-purpose library kernels and independent oracle.
acceptance: Method/dt ownership documented
Energy, stability and control oracle tests
No reduction in supported physical model class

packages.title: Audio and RF library rates/effects ownership
packages.scope: Audit sample/frame units, parameter smoothing, spans, hidden memory allocation, DSP kernels and capabilities at host side; avoid effects inside audio callback.
acceptance: Golden-output tests and performance baseline
Unsupported timing guarantees not advertised
New public wrappers remain compatible or versioned

packages.title: Evolve canonical nonproof examples systematically
packages.scope: Apply per-file adoption decisions, leave pedagogical hand-integration and independently tested references intentional, update first-hit tours after proof.
acceptance: All selected migrations have before/after model oracle
Each preserved low-level exception tagged
No generated example status report hand-edited

packages.title: Audited package/registry APIs and portability
packages.scope: Review package boundaries, effects, ownership/borrow API, experimental semantics, version requirements and C vs MLIR parity; migrate one library per PR.
acceptance: Current package compatibility baseline recorded
No inadvertent ABI or dependency break
Reference test proves preserved behavior

packages.title: Unified semantic idiom-advisor rules
packages.scope: Build on shipped FIDIOM001/FIDIOM002, deduplicate equivalent rule logic between CLI and LSP and add advisory-but-not-autofix representation hints tied to verified feature versions.
acceptance: Same diagnostic ID/span/rationale and suppression across CLI and LSP
Fixes only when demonstrably behavior preserving
Advisory architectural hints do not create code edits

packages.title: Compiler aware editor and formatting synchronization
packages.scope: Align hover, completion, source spans, syntax-aware formatter and snippets with feature registry; negative examples should not surface futuristic syntax.
acceptance: Identical feature ID/status in hover and docs
Formatting stable under roundtrip
LSP golden transcript tests updated from actual output

packages.title: Documentation and grammar reconciliation
packages.scope: Replace stale feature/architecture statements, map grammar accurately, flag proposals and pre-parse expanders explicitly and preserve dated design history.
acceptance: All current feature claims trace to tests and exact host/backend state
Retired Python-host references corrected, or labelled historical
Documentation snippets compile at their advertised target

packages.title: Problem-first tutorials, book and AI handbook
packages.scope: Teach selection of representation by domain and problem with anti-examples, unsupported cases, units/equations/evolves/effects, performance and target limitations. No fabricated examples.
acceptance: Each feature has working, linked example and negative case
Human and agent-facing guidance agree
Book/handbook claims carry verifiable versioned links

packages.title: Website, playground, WASM and gallery accuracy
packages.scope: Make modern syntax discoverable, live examples actually executable on their advertised backends, and browser/editor accessibility correct. Coordinate with existing PR #1707.
acceptance: Browser executes real built WASM when labelled live, no fake JS proxy
Playground parser/highlight understands active syntax
Built wiki links and keyboard/browser checks pass

packages.title: Agent skill and first-turn selection evaluation
packages.scope: Give a model with just the repo URL a deterministic read/claim/select/test/PR process for this programme; publish evaluated guidance to downstream flow-skills without duplicating language truths.
acceptance: New agent identifies queue, overlap, next eligible task without human-provided detailed prompt
Fails closed on unavailable GitHub access or semantic approval
Adversarial agent prompts reject future syntax and cargo-culting

packages.title: Grammar consumers and syntax-highlighting parity
packages.scope: Keep repository editor/browser source displays compatible with actual compiler syntax and coordinate downstream tree-sitter/tmLanguage updates without claiming they are parser oracles.
acceptance: Representative syntax highlights correctly in compiled docs browser
Unsupported constructs are not rendered as runnable
Differential source corpus includes current constructs

packages.title: Portable feature-collision and benchmark showcase
packages.scope: Select a coherent subset of advanced patterns that survive together with target guarantees. Compare complexity/CPU/runtime costs to meaningful low-level alternatives, avoid all-features stunt files.
acceptance: Exact-revision C+MLIR or explicitly target-only verification
Program checks before timings
Numerics, memory, effects and ownership collisions tested

packages.title: Modernize Flow Idiomatics corpus and claims
packages.scope: Update target-specific and obsolete Python-host claims; promote compiler-verified examples; keep low-level counterexamples and portable manifest executable.
acceptance: Each showcase has target, compiler version and proof
STYLE not a second source of syntax truth
C run and MLIR verifier for portable set

packages.title: Herbie dimensioned automotive and engineering models
packages.scope: Unify dimensioned equation-first vehicle model, port topology, sampled control and manufacturing tolerances with hand RK4/MNA as independent references; do not imply universal Simulink/Simscape parity.
acceptance: Analytic trajectory, energy, dimensional and covariance negative tests
Pure reference retained and checked against generated RK4
Compiler pinned, no unverified production-safety claim

packages.title: Flow Audio real-time, rate and capability modernization
packages.scope: Audit sample/frame-rate contracts, spans, callback effects, host boundary, automation and model DSL where applicable; prove golden audio and bounded allocation behavior.
acceptance: CMajor feature parity not overstated
No hidden allocation/block inside callback
Version and latency test baseline preserved

packages.title: Flow DSP sample-equivalence modernization
packages.scope: Audit structured DSP state, numerical determinism, units/rates and API boundaries; migrate only where compiler semantics preserve sample-by-sample output.
acceptance: Golden impulse/step/WAV checks
Aliasing, coefficient and sample order unchanged or versioned
Benchmark provenance recorded

packages.title: Flow Skills instructions, examples and evaluation parity
packages.scope: Update installed public agent skills and syntax card with verified idioms, decision tree, executable examples, version/backend gates and clear future syntax labels.
acceptance: Sample model produces valid Flow for current compiler
Conflicting skill instructions removed
Regression evaluation includes refusing overuse

packages.title: Tree-sitter and tmLanguage current grammar
packages.scope: Sync current syntax categories, units, equations, flow/evolves, handlers, patterns, contextual keywords and doc status without claiming grammar handles semantic lowering.
acceptance: Grammar corpus accepts supported source forms
Editor highlight examples crosscheck
No syntax invented ahead of compiler

packages.title: Secondary compiler and other dependent repos governance
packages.scope: Decide whether flow-compiler is a distribution/mirror or maintained branch; identify other consumers by actual manifests and pins and avoid diverging grammar sources.
acceptance: One canonical compiler semantics owner
Mirrors specify sync/compatibility policy
Downstream change list grounded in actual dependencies

packages.title: Regression-proof release and CI ratchet
packages.scope: Extend existing CI gates for feature status, snippets, editor and agent selection; respect release candidate freeze and existing CODEOWNERS. Do not add expensive duplicate workflows.
acceptance: Ratchets baseline-green before enforcement
No skipped required checks treated as evidence of semantic success
Exact-head merge-group and release qualification records

packages.title: Adoption metrics and exceptions audit
packages.scope: Produce deterministic, per-revision scorecards for eligible domain models, approved exceptions, stale feature claims, suggestion precision, backend coverage, runtime and cost regressions; report without changing semantics.
acceptance: Denominator explicitly excludes proof/fixtures/reference code
Measured before/after selection and false positives
No blanket target percentage before baseline

packages.title: Close migration and maintain continuing work
packages.scope: Validate programme exit criteria, link accepted evidence, merge/close duplicated work and leave a maintainable process for future language features; no promise of universal MATLAB or backend parity.
acceptance: Every adopted feature has accurate compiler, IDE, documentation and model consumer evidence
Remaining gaps tracked and explicitly qualified
Agents now pick the correct supported idiom in held-out evals
